name: Signup form flip
oneLiner: a clean sign-up form card on a warm lit desk: the focus ring hops field to field as a name, an email and a password type in with small green ticks and a strength meter filling green, a pointer presses Create account, the button spins and the card flips over to the brand mark with a green check and a Welcome with the typed first name
say: when the speaker says how easy it is to join or how people sign up ('you just make an account', 'thirty seconds and you are in'): the fields fill as they explain, the card flips to the welcome on 'you are in' or 'done'
